items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: I don't know whether you ever heard of the Werleins. Sure. Did you? George Werlein? Yeah. Jack Werlein? Yeah.

ctx.x: mother and father play instruments? My father did.

What did he play? He played guitar. He did. Now, was he good? Well, I guess you'd call him good for those days. But your memory of his playing was he was all right? Oh, yes. He played the right key and everything. I mean, he didn't interpose any chords and stuff like they do today. It's all advanced. Straight stuff. Yes, he played only straight. They used to be fellas, I don't know whether you ever heard of the Werleins. Sure. Did you? George Werlein? Yeah. Jack Werlein? Yeah. Julie Oates? No, I don't remember.…
as a kid, how'd you do about lugging that thing around? Well, I didn't carry it.
